name: 03 · TYPED FILTER COMPONENTS / States and query groups

children.name: Typed filter library title
children.content: Typed filters / One system across modules

children.name: Typed library description
children.content: 44 px default controls · 36 px compact controls · 14 px values in both modes · 13 px labels · 12 px helper text. Selection mode, state and field type are explicit. Scope and Status always constrain condition groups with AND.

children.name: Field / Relationship lookup
children.context: Permission-scoped relationship lookup. Schema supplies single/multiple selection and stable entity IDs. Changing parent retains valid selections; unavailable selections require correction. Search changes options only. Debounced responses never clear selected values.

children.name: Field / Boolean filter
children.context: Any is unrestricted; Yes and No are distinct predicates. Unknown/missing data is a separate optional operator, never conflated with No.

children.name: Field / Number range
children.context: Canonical number range: one normalized criterion with inclusive min/max. Either bound may be open; 0 is valid. Blank means unrestricted, never zero. Area accepts non-negative decimal hectares and normalizes to m² without silently rounding the query. Reject min > max and out-of-range values inline; module schema supplies units and precision.

children.name: Area range guidance
children.content: Leave either limit empty for an open range.

children.name: Field / Date range
children.context: Date-only From/To are inclusive in workspace timezone Asia/Kolkata. Last 30 days is rolling through now; saved views retain the relative preset. Custom dates remain fixed. End before start is invalid; empty endpoints are open bounds.

children.name: Date timezone
children.content: Dates use Asia/Kolkata · End date included

children.name: Field / Text filter
children.context: Text filter applies to its named field, separate from global page search. Operators: contains, equals, starts with, is empty. Empty input is unrestricted. Whitespace-only input adds no criterion. Case handling is defined by field schema.

children.name: Filter / Condition group
children.context: Reusable query group. All means AND, Any means OR. Status, global scope and search stay outside editable groups. Children are typed conditions or nested groups. Removing a group removes its full subtree. Basic conversion is allowed only when every clause is losslessly representable.

children.name: Filter / Applied group summary
children.context: Atomic applied group. Edit reopens Advanced; remove removes whole group with Undo. This example counts two conditions, not one chip.

children.name: Applied group expression
children.content: Role is Supervisor OR Last active before 01 Oct 2026

children.name: Neutral and scope semantics
children.content:
Scope + Status AND (conditions).
Multi-value = 1 criterion; range = 1; unrestricted = 0.
Group count = its normalized conditions.
Reset changes the draft; Clear filters changes applied fields. Search and global scope stay.

children.name: Range correction
children.content: Minimum must be less than or equal to maximum.

children.name: Open picker and compact summary specimens
Keyboard contract
children.content: Picker: label + current value + selection mode. Focus is distinct from selection. Arrow keys navigate; Space toggles multi-selection. Escape closes the picker first and returns focus to the field. The panel traps focus and restores it to the original trigger after closing. No second Apply inside a picker.

children.name: Data contract
children.content: Relationship options are permission scoped. Parent changes preserve valid selections and identify unavailable ones. Requests are keyed to the current field/search; stale responses cannot replace newer options. A failed preview never appears as zero matches.

children.name: Responsive contract
children.content: At narrower widths, stack paired fields and condition rows. Keep the header and footer reachable. Chip summaries use a first value plus overflow count; full values remain available in the picker. Status becomes a select when its labels no longer fit.

children.name: Grouped query and adaptive layout examples
Applied grouped query and Basic guard
Applied scope
children.content: People · Status: Active · Site: Mundra Port

children.name: Applied summary removal contract
children.content: The entire OR group is one summary item. Edit opens Advanced at this group. Remove removes the whole group and updates results; it never deletes just one side of OR.

xpUcm.content: Site = Mundra AND (Role = Supervisor OR Last active before 01 Oct 2026) cannot be represented in Basic. Keep editing in Advanced, or reset the draft filters. Applied results stay unchanged until Apply.

children.name: Basic reset scope
children.content: Reset to Basic clears Status and condition groups in the pending draft only. It keeps global company/site scope and page search. Cancel restores the applied query.

children.name: Text enlargement scope
children.content: Design specimen: control text enlarged from 14 to 28 px. Field, operator and value stack; actions grow with labels. Runtime zoom and keyboard testing remain required.

children.name: Adaptive row guidance
children.content: Use the stacked variant when text or container width makes inline controls too narrow. Keep complete values available in the picker. At text zoom, scroll the panel body and keep Apply / Cancel reachable.

children.name: Status fallback rule
children.content: Use a single-select picker instead of the segmented row when there are more than four statuses or long labels. All remains the explicit unrestricted option; selected state never relies on color alone.

children.name: More applied criteria
children.context: Opens the applied criteria list with full labels and individual remove actions. OR groups remain atomic.

children.name: Count and time semantics
children.content: Badge count = normalized active criteria, including restricted Status once. One multi-value field = 1; one range = 1. Groups disclose their internal condition count. Search and global scope are excluded.

children.name: Date and quantity semantics
children.content: Dates use the workspace timezone, inclusive day endpoints and rolling relative presets. Open numeric bounds are unrestricted; 0 is valid. Area uses ha, normalized to m². Any / blank adds no restriction; Is empty / Is not empty explicitly targets missing values.
